name: stat-card
purpose: A KPI / metric card: a headline value (a number formatted with Intl.NumberFormat or formatValue, preformatted text, or 'No value') with its label and optional icon; an optional change against a previous value (arrow icon, signed amount, and a visually hidden spelled-out text such as 'increase of 20%, favorable', so the meaning never depends on color or the arrow); a comparison caption; an optional trend Sparkline; and supporting text. Sentiment (higher-is-better, lower-is-better, neutral) decides whether a change reads and is colored as favorable. A role=group named by the label; with href the whole card is a single link (URL policy: http(s) and relative only).
whenToUse: Headline metrics on dashboards: revenue, active users, error rate, with the change since the previous period.
KPI tiles that link to a detail page (href).
whenNotToUse: Comparing many values or showing a series in detail: use a chart or Data Table.
Progress toward a goal: use Progress Bar (or a gauge chart).
Cards with several interactive controls: use Card.
responsive: Fills its container (block-size 100% so it fills a Dashboard Grid cell). Text wraps (overflow-wrap: anywhere); the value uses tabular numerals. The trend sparkline is the full card width and 2rem tall.
rtl: Logical properties throughout; the sparkline receives the resolved direction. Numbers and signs are formatted by Intl for the locale.
theme: color-surface, color-border, and radius-lg for the card; a favorable change uses color-success-fg, an unfavorable one color-error-fg, neutral color-text; the arrow and the spelled-out text carry the same meaning without color. Link hover uses color-hover and color-border-strong. Forced-colors mode uses CanvasText for the border and all change colors.
security: All text (label, value, comparison, description, spoken change) is rendered with textContent. href is validated with the URL policy (http, https, or scheme-less relative URLs; javascript:, data:, and other schemes throw STAT_CARD_OPTIONS). No HTML sinks; CSP-safe.
dataHandling: No persistence, network access, or telemetry. Values are formatted locally; the change is computed from value and previous (or taken from delta).

budgets.budget: < 2 ms in headless Chromium (e2e performance test)

performance.testedScale: Dashboards of tens of cards; trend arrays are passed to Sparkline (see its limits).

limitations: The trend sparkline needs the Sparkline stylesheet (@absoluteui/components/sparkline/style.css) in addition to the Stat Card stylesheet.
A percent change from a previous value of 0 is not shown (division by zero); pass delta explicitly if needed.
The change is computed only when value is a number; with a preformatted string value pass delta.
href cannot be added or removed after create (recreate the card).
With formatValue and deltaFormat 'absolute', a positive change is prefixed with '+' and a negative one relies on formatValue to print the minus sign.
Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
unsupported: HTML in the label, value, comparison, or description.
Buttons or other controls inside the card.
antiPatterns: Encoding favorable/unfavorable only with color: set sentiment so the spelled-out text is correct.
Using lower-is-better metrics (error rate, cost) with the default higher-is-better sentiment.
Wrapping the card in another link instead of using href.

adapters.angular: @absoluteui/angular/stat-card: generated AuiStatCard directive ([auiStatCard] on an empty host); inputs mirror the options.
adapters.react: @absoluteui/react/stat-card: generated AuiStatCard component; props mirror the options.
adapters.vue: @absoluteui/vue/stat-card: generated AuiStatCard component; props mirror the options.
